mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_plan) AS total_plan_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_plan WHERE status = 'PLANNED') AS planned_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_plan WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS') AS in_progress_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_plan WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_request WHERE status = 'SHORTAGE') AS shortage_request_count

SELECT pp.production_plan_id, pp.department_id, pp.item_id, pp.production_qty, pp.start_date, pp.due_date, pp.status, pp.created_by, pp.created_at, pp.updated_at, i.item_code, i.item_name, d.department_name, u.user_name AS created_by_name FROM production_plan pp JOIN item i ON i.item_id = pp.item_id JOIN department d ON d.department_id = pp.department_id JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = pp.created_by ORDER BY pp.created_at DESC, pp.production_plan_id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT mr.request_id, mr.production_plan_id, mr.department_id, mr.item_id, mr.request_qty, mr.issued_qty, mr.required_date, mr.status, mr.requested_by, mr.processed_by, mr.issued_at, mr.created_at, mr.updated_at, i.item_code, i.item_name, d.department_name, requester.user_name AS requested_by_name, processor.user_name AS processed_by_name FROM material_request mr JOIN item i ON i.item_id = mr.item_id JOIN department d ON d.department_id = mr.department_id JOIN app_user requester ON requester.user_id = mr.requested_by LEFT JOIN app_user processor ON processor.user_id = mr.processed_by ORDER BY mr.created_at DESC, mr.request_id DESC LIMIT 5
